🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION regime. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive; weak breadth plus a MAJOR divergence (multiple large caps with 1W up / 1M down) confirm mixed signals and argue for caution rather than a strong directional call.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology lead pockets: PANW (1W: +23.41% | 1M: +17.16%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +10.52% | 1M: +42.07%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +9.91% | 1M: +2.17%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare showing strength: JNJ (1W: +5.39% | 1M: +13.63%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +6.67% | 1M: +10.12%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials pockets: HD (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +13.77%) ABOVE TREND and CAT (1W: -0.31% | 1M: +14.57%) TREND EXHAUSTION.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities and Real Estate are weakest: CEG (1W: -11.74% | 1M: -10.99%) BELOW TREND, DLR (1W: -8.65% | 1M: -4.06%) BELOW TREND. Communication Services also lagging with VZ (1W: -8.08% | 1M: -12.03%) BELOW TREND and T (1W: -8.45% | 1M: -16.58%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: PANW (1W: +23.41% | 1M: +17.16%) ABOVE TREND, TSLA (1W: +13.25% | 1M: +2.27%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +12.79% | 1M: -22.13%) RECOVERY, VLO (1W: +11.14% | 1M: +6.70%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +10.78% | 1M: -21.74%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Technology); Style mixed / no clear leadership given weak breadth.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: QCOM (1W: -7.85% | 1M: -20.26%) BELOW TREND, DOW (1W: -8.03% | 1M: -22.11%) BELOW TREND, VZ (1W: -8.08% | 1M: -12.03%) BELOW TREND, TJX (1W: -8.37% | 1M: -0.92%) BELOW TREND, T (1W: -8.45% | 1M: -16.58%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Communications and Materials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: PANW (1W: +23.41% | 1M: +17.16%) ABOVE TREND, TSLA (1W: +13.25% | 1M: +2.27%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +12.79% | 1M: -22.13%) RECOVERY, VLO (1W: +11.14% | 1M: +6.70%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +10.52% | 1M: +42.07%) ABOVE TREND — note MAJOR divergence: several large caps in RECOVERY (NOW, PLTR, IBM) and core names sliding, so treat momentum as tactical until confirmed.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is mixed: AMAT (1W: +10.52% | 1M: +42.07%) ABOVE TREND and META (1W: +9.91% | 1M: +2.17%) ABOVE TREND versus NVDA (1W: -0.71% | 1M: -11.83%) BELOW TREND and ORCL (1W: -9.54% | 1M: -42.58%) BELOW TREND — sector showing internal rotation with headline strength but notable core divergences.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials show pockets of strength: JPM (1W: +0.19% | 1M: +12.64%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +8.77%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +5.49%) ABOVE TREND — sector breadth supportive versus weak overall market breadth.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare constructive but watch headline risk: JNJ (1W: +5.39% | 1M: +13.63%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +5.11% | 1M: +12.93%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +6.67% | 1M: +10.12%) ABOVE TREND; however MRK/AMGN headlines introduce idiosyncratic downside risk.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective Financials and Healthcare leaders (JPM (1W: +0.19% | 1M: +12.64%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +5.39% | 1M: +13.63%) ABOVE TREND) and maintain exposure to high-quality Tech winners (AMAT (1W: +10.52% | 1M: +42.07%) ABOVE TREND). Reduce exposure to names showing MAJOR divergence or clear break in 1M trend (NOW (1W: +12.79% | 1M: -22.13%) RECOVERY, ORCL (1W: -9.54% | 1M: -42.58%) BELOW TREND).

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: PANW (1W: +23.41% | 1M: +17.16%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +10.52% | 1M: +42.07%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +9.91% | 1M: +2.17%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ORCL (1W: -9.54% | 1M: -42.58%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -7.85% | 1M: -20.26%) BELOW TREND, T (1W: -8.45% | 1M: -16.58%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare and selective Technology (Healthcare 1W: +2.70% | 1M: +6.80%; Technology 1W: +3.95% | 1M: -6.64%) — watch leadership confirmation. BEARISH: Utilities and Real Estate (Utilities 1W: -2.68% | 1M: +3.30%; Real Estate 1W: -2.03% | 1M: +1.87%) given recent underperformance.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA (1W: -0.71% | 1M: -11.83%) BELOW TREND for any reclaim of multi-week support as confirmation; AAPL (1W: +0.44% | 1M: -3.89%) RECOVERY needs 1W follow-through to validate reversal; JPM (1W: +0.19% | 1M: +12.64%) ABOVE TREND continuation would confirm Financials leadership.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (+75): LLY (1W: +6.67% | 1M: +10.12%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment (Medicare/GLP-1 inclusion) confirming price strength. CVX (+60): CVX (1W: -3.36% | 1M: -10.84%) BELOW TREND — bullish deal news but price diverging, watch for follow-through. Note: several high-sentiment names in the news feed lack explicit 1W/1M data in the provided slice.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
DOW (-50): DOW (1W: -8.03% | 1M: -22.11%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price both negative, confirmed. CAT (-55): CAT (1W: -0.31% | 1M: +14.57%) TREND EXHAUSTION — negative headlines create tactical risk despite 1M strength. T (-50): T (1W: -8.45% | 1M: -16.58%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price aligned to the downside.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION regime; Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive and style mixed / no clear leadership. PANW (1W: +23.41% | 1M: +17.16%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +10.52% | 1M: +42.07%) ABOVE TREND and JPM (1W: +0.19% | 1M: +12.64%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is MAJOR divergence — multiple large caps in RECOVERY or BELOW TREND (NOW, AAPL, MSFT, ORCL, QCOM) and several sentiment-price divergences (LLY/CVX) that require confirmation.
